{{Quote|What are they buying and selling?"<br />"Weapons. Spice. Illegal medicines they will sell to the unfortunates in the galaxy. Fortunes are being made down there. And those fortunes are built on the ashes of our civilization.|Euranna Fall briefs Anakin Skywalker about the criminal-trading activity on the planet Mawan|<ref name="Jedi Quest: The Shadow Trap">''[[Jedi Quest: The Shadow Trap]]''</ref>}}
'''Euraana Fall''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mawan (species)|Mawan]] who served as a liaison to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yaddle/Legends|Yaddle]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], who were [[Mission to Mawan|dispatched]] to [[Mawan/Legends|Mawan]] by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] to help establish a peaceful government on the planet, [[25 BBY/Legends|three years]] before the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]].

Euraana's pink skin and blue veins earned her the respect and admiration of other members of the Mawan upper class. She greatly desired to restore Mawan to its former beauty, so much so that she was willing to work with the lower classes to achieve her goal.
